versions.subject: Converted Sysmon/1 and Security/4688 to generic process creation rules
Added missing tags and some minor improvements
fix: fixed missing date fields in remaining files
Widen the search as it gives too many false negatives
feat: more updates
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - OriginalFileName:
        - 'wscript.exe'
        - 'cscript.exe'
    - Image|endswith:
        - '\wscript.exe'
        - '\cscript.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '.js'
        - '.jse'
        - '.vba'
        - '.vbe'
        - '.vbs'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: OriginalFileName IN ("wscript.exe", "cscript.exe") OR Image IN ("*\\wscript.exe", "*\\cscript.exe") CommandLine IN ("*.js*", "*.jse*", "*.vba*", "*.vbe*", "*.vbs*")
